<!-- Fixture text for testing the site. It is not a page of the wiki and never ships. -->

Inside zone is a run play that asks each lineman to block a gap or the defender who fills it,
instead of a named defender.

## The idea

Linemen step in the same direction and block the area they land in. The back takes the handoff and
runs to the point where the line has made a crease.

## Where coaches differ

Coach Example One teaches the back to press the line of scrimmage before cutting. Coach Example
Two teaches a quicker cut at the first gap that opens. Both coaches agree on the footwork of the
line.
## Assignments

| Position | Assignment |
| --- | --- |
| Play-side tackle | Steps with the play-side foot and blocks the defender in his play-side gap. |
| Play-side guard | Works with the center on the nose, then climbs to the linebacker. |
| Center | Steps play side and takes over the nose when the guard leaves. |

1. The back opens to the play side.
2. He presses the line of scrimmage.

The coach's cue is "slow to, fast through".
